data.title: Contribution notice for voluntary health insurance from 1 June 2026
data.summary: Allgemeine Musterkasse set your voluntary health and long-term care insurance contributions at €530.85 per month from 1 June 2026. The amount is collected by direct debit on the 15th of the following month.
data.explanation: This is a contribution decision (Beitragsbescheid) from your health insurer. Health insurance is €412.65 and long-term care insurance (Pflegeversicherung) is €118.20, together €530.85 a month. The amount is debited automatically, so make sure your account has enough money. If you think the amount is wrong, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person. The app shows until when. Check the amount against your income documents. A tax adviser can help if you are unsure.
data.tax_note: Health and long-term care insurance contributions can generally be deducted as special expenses (Sonderausgaben) in your tax return.
